title: Oven Roasted French Beef Pot Au Feu
description: A hearty and romantic French dish featuring tender beef and vegetables in a rich herbal broth, served in a bento box.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the beef short ribs with salt and pepper.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat and sear the beef short ribs until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced red bell pepper, chopped onion, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the thyme, bay leaves, and garlic to the pot and stir to combine.
Pour in the beef broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the pot au feu for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Strain the broth and discard the solids.
Serve the pot au feu in a bento box, garnished with fresh thyme.
